implementation.targetScope: React19 explicit-ref Transition, CSSTransition and TransitionGroup used by MUI7.2.0 navigation Collapse, Fade/Grow/Slide/Zoom, ButtonBase ripple and MUI X8.7.0 date-calendar transitions. SwitchTransition, ReplaceTransition and legacy implicit findDOMNode are outside scope.

changes: No runtime dependencies beyond the React peer; class operations use native classList directly.
Each transition owns a cancellable operation and timer; obsolete completions cannot win after reversal or unmount.
CSS bookkeeping uses the actual owner node and removes its managed classes on unmount.
Types require explicit refs for live React19 transitions; CJS/ESM root and component subpaths are provided.
Group exit callbacks keep their identity across parent renders, preserving effect-driven MUI ripple completion.
